meta_description: Tony White is a professional painter and decorator in Newcastle. Interior and exterior work, quality finishes, free quotes. Call 07866 056213 today.
hero_subhead: From interior redecorating to full exterior work, Tony transforms homes across Newcastle with attention to detail and clean, professional finishes.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services for Newcastle Homes
services_subhead: Whether you need a single room refreshed or a full house transformation, Tony handles interior and exterior work with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Redecorating
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, and woodwork painted to a flawless finish. Tony preps every surface properly so the new colour lasts for years.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Fascia, soffits, doors, and render work completed in all weathers. Weather-resistant finishes protect your home and boost kerb appeal.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging
services.desc: Professional wallpaper installation with clean seams and no bubbles. We remove old paper, prepare walls, and hang new patterns perfectly.

services.title: Wood Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting, and pine work painted or varnished to your exact specification. Undercoat and top coat applied for durability.

services.title: Artexing & Ceiling Work
services.desc: Textured ceiling finishes applied evenly and professionally. Repairs to damaged artex, or removal if you prefer a smooth look.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Office spaces, retail units, and communal areas redecorated on schedule and within budget. We work flexibly around your business hours.

about_pullquote: I take pride in doing work I'd be happy to see in my own home.
about_para_1: Tony White set up his decorating business over 20 years ago with a simple goal: deliver quality paintwork at a fair price, without the fuss. Starting as a one-man operation, he's built a reputation across Newcastle for reliability and meticulous attention to detail. Every job — whether a small bedroom or a full commercial refurb — gets the same care and precision.
about_para_2: Homeowners and landlords in Newcastle return to Tony because he shows up on time, protects your furniture and floors, and leaves the property spotless. He listens to what you want, offers honest advice on colour and finish, and completes work on budget. No high-pressure upsells, no cutting corners — just professional decorating you can trust.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Tony White

reviews.text: Tony came highly recommended and didn't disappoint. He redecorated our lounge and hallway in two days — the finish is immaculate. He was tidy, polite, and even gave us advice on colour combinations. Will definitely be booking him again for the rest of the house.
reviews.author: Margaret D.

reviews.text: Had the exterior of our semi painted by Tony last summer. The prep work was thorough, he used quality paint, and the job looks as good now as the day he finished. Prices are reasonable and he's very professional. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Peter K.

reviews.text: We were nervous about having tradespeople in during lockdown, but Tony was brilliant — masked up, kept everything sanitised, and worked alone so minimal disruption. Brilliant painter, honestly. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Susan B.
